Travel by Aeromarine-Always Over the Water
IT'S COMFORTABLE FASCINATING SAFE
Flying is now recognized as a safe and delightful method of travel
provided you fly with a well-organized, properly equipped, amply financed
company of proven reliability, and avoid unsafe stunt machines and irre-
sponsible operators.
We are the largest Aerial Transportation Company in
the world operating flying boats; have flown over one million passenger miles
without a single mishap, and have established a world's record for safety.
The reliability of the Aeromarine Flying Boat service has been clearly
demonstrated during the past three years of operations-thousands of air
flights—in absolute safety.
Passengers enjoy even more comfort than pro-
vided by trains or steamers and save many hours in travel.
